description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom TextView component used for displaying log entries in an Android application. It implements the LogNode interface, formats log data, and supports chaining of log nodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView widget that outputs log data received through the LogNode interface, formatting the log entries and displaying them in the UI.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log data and outputs it to the LogView, handling different log levels, exceptions, and ensuring UI thread safety.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append strings with delimiters if they are not null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView display.
